label: Meta AI (WhatsApp Web)
login_hint: Switch to the browser workspace (default 8) and scan the QR code with your phone (WhatsApp → Settings → Linked devices). The profile keeps the session; you only do this once.
consent_js: () => { const names = ['got it', 'ok, got it', 'accept', 'continue', 'update', 'later', 'not now', 'zrozumiano', 'zaakceptuj', 'kontynuuj', 'później', 'nie teraz']; const btns = [...document.querySelectorAll('button, div[role="button"]')]; for (const name of names) { const b = btns.find(x => (x.innerText || x.getAttribute('aria-label') || '').trim().toLowerCase() === name); if (b) { b.click(); return name; } } return null; }
state_js: () => { const msgs = [...document.querySelectorAll('div[data-id][data-testid^="conv-msg-"]')]; const isUser = m => !!m.querySelector('[data-icon="check"], [data-icon="check-check"], [data-icon="clock"], [data-testid="msg-check"]'); const isSystem = m => !!m.querySelector('[data-testid="system_message"]'); const ai = msgs.filter(m => !isUser(m) && !isSystem(m) && m.innerText && m.innerText.trim()); const last = ai[ai.length - 1]; if (!last) return { ready: false }; const clean = t => (t || '').split('\n').filter(l => !/^\s*\d{1,2}:\d{2}\s*(am|pm)?\s*$/i.test(l) && !/^(Today|Yesterday|Dzisiaj|Wczoraj)$/i.test(l.trim())).join('\n').trim(); return { ready: true, text: clean(last.innerText), complete: false }; }
turn_count_js: () => { const msgs = [...document.querySelectorAll('div[data-id][data-testid^="conv-msg-"]')]; const isUser = m => !!m.querySelector('[data-icon="check"], [data-icon="check-check"], [data-icon="clock"], [data-testid="msg-check"]'); return msgs.filter(isUser).length; }
pane_text_js: () => { const main = document.querySelector('#main, div[data-testid="conversation-panel"]'); return main ? main.innerText : ''; }
extract_js: () => { const msgs = [...document.querySelectorAll('div[data-id][data-testid^="conv-msg-"]')]; const isUser = m => !!m.querySelector('[data-icon="check"], [data-icon="check-check"], [data-icon="clock"], [data-testid="msg-check"]'); const isSystem = m => !!m.querySelector('[data-testid="system_message"]'); const out = { answer: '', sources: [], turns: msgs.filter(isUser).length }; const ai = msgs.filter(m => !isUser(m) && !isSystem(m) && m.innerText && m.innerText.trim()); const last = ai[ai.length - 1]; const clean = t => (t || '').split('\n').filter(l => !/^\s*\d{1,2}:\d{2}\s*(am|pm)?\s*$/i.test(l) && !/^(Today|Yesterday|Dzisiaj|Wczoraj)$/i.test(l.trim())).join('\n').trim(); if (last) { out.answer = clean(last.innerText); last.querySelectorAll('a[href^="http"]').forEach(a => { const href = a.getAttribute('href'); if (href && !out.sources.some(s => s.href === href)) out.sources.push({ site: '', title: a.innerText.trim(), snippet: '', href }); }); } return out; }
